comment: Frontend deploys from the monorepo. Set the Vercel project Root Directory to 'frontend' in the dashboard (Vercel does not read rootDirectory from this file). NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE must be set per environment: Production -> the Render backend URL (https://arepo-api.onrender.com), Preview -> the same or a staging backend. No localhost references ship to production. Creating the Vercel project and setting env vars requires the user.
